lede: Monolingual Thai accounts for 24 catalogued manuscripts, 10 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phrae (33% of the corpus for this language), ahead of Nan and Lampang. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (92%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (4%). Dated witnesses run 1905–2024 CE (4 of 24 carry a date).
